title: OpenAI’s Computing Lead Sachin Katti to Depart In November
text:
Sachin Katti, vice president of compute strategy at OpenAI, said Wednesday he was leaving the role on November 15 after about a year at OpenAI. Katti, who joined OpenAI after four years at Intel, announced that he would be “moving on to build something new” in a post on X.
